2120311798939214287.en_summary: EliteOptions2 discusses trading psychology: knowing rules and following them are different skills. Examples of breaking rules like sizing up, jumping in, averaging down (lost $800k on $NQ), opening more charts. Advice: grade trades on plan adherence not P&L, count rule breaks, credit for sitting out, never average down, protect capital. Habit building comes first.
2120311798939214287.zh_summary: EliteOptions2討論交易心理：知道規則和遵守規則是不同技能。例子包括加大倉位、跳入、攤平（在$NQ上虧損80萬美元）、打開更多圖表。建議：根據是否遵守計劃而非盈虧評分交易，計算每週破規次數，給予觀望信用，永不攤平，保護資本。先建立習慣。
